- `find SURNAME YEAR [topic words]`: search Crossref by author and publication year, e.g. `find LeCun 2015 deep learning`. Shows up to 5 results as an APA 7 preview; they are never Verified.

- `accept N`: confirm a Check reference once you have checked it yourself, so it goes in the export, e.g. `accept 3`.
